description: The Rotary Club Of Mumbai North Island Conducted An Engaging Financial Literacy Workshop At Duruelo Convent High School, With The Objective Of Introducing Students To Essential Money-Management Skills & Encouraging Smart Financial Habits From An Early Age. The Session Was Conducted By Mr. Tanuj Podar, Who Explained Important Financial Concepts In A Simple, Interactive & Child-Friendly Manner. His Engaging Approach Made The Session Easy To Understand & Encouraged Active Participation Among The Students. The Workshop Focused On Building Financial Awareness, Promoting Responsible Money Management & Helping Children Understand The Importance Of Saving, Planning & Making Informed Financial Decisions.
